arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
reflection: Ease is intertwined with difficulty; patience during trial always yields relief.

arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
reflection: Whatever burden you carry today, your soul was built with the resilience to withstand it.

translation: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
reflection: True calmness of mind and spirit is unlocked through mindful gratitude and remembrance.

translation: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah.
reflection: Make your intention with diligence, take focused action, and place your trust in the outcome.

translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.
reflection: Every sincere effort toward personal growth and good deeds is met with divine clarity.

translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested you.
reflection: Even in periods of quiet or stagnation, you are never abandoned.

translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].
reflection: Gratitude expands blessings, opens doors to contentment, and elevates peace of mind.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
reflection: When your reliance is rooted deeply, fear of circumstance fades into tranquility.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ
translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer.
reflection: Patience is active perseverance coupled with spiritual stillness.

translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
reflection: A humble, continuous pursuit of wisdom and understanding opens life to true depth.
